name: Innuendo
overview: Scripture addresses the subtle and often deceptive nature of innuendo through vivid imagery, such as winking with the eye to convey hidden meanings or malice. Psalms 35:19 warns against enemies who rejoice falsely and communicate hatred through such secretive gestures. Proverbs 6:13 and 10:10 further illustrate how these covert signals can lead to sorrow and downfall, highlighting the destructive power of insincere or manipulative expressions. Together, these verses caution believers to guard their speech and conduct against deceitful insinuations that harm others and disrupt righteousness.
